products.title: KuKirin X1 Electric Off-Road Motorcycle | 48V 20.8Ah Battery | 1000W Mid-Drive Motor
products.body_html:
The KUKIRIN X1 is a powerful electric moped built for urban commuting and light off-road riding. It features a 48V 1000W mid-drive motor with a peak output of 2000W, delivering strong acceleration and a top speed of 50 km/h across three selectable speed modes. The 48V 20.8Ah lithium-ion battery provides a range of up to 40km at medium speed, while the IP65 waterproof rating and integrated BMS ensure safe and reliable operation.

Safety and control come from front and rear hydraulic disc brakes paired with an electronic brake, offering confident stopping power. The lightweight 6061 aluminum alloy frame is supported by hydraulic damping front and rear suspension, absorbing shocks on uneven terrain. Off-road pneumatic tires on 14-inch front and 12-inch rear wheels provide excellent traction, and the LED display keeps riders informed of speed, gear, battery, and mileage at a glance.

With a maximum load of 120kg and a complete accessory kit included, the KUKIRIN X1 offers a dependable and enjoyable ride for everyday adventures.


48V 20.8Ah Battery

1000W Rated motor

up to 40 km per charge

50 kph Max. Speed

14'' & 12'' Pneumatic tire
